Class SocketServerNetworkAdapter

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.network.socket.SocketServerNetworkAdapter
All Implemented Interfaces:
ServerNetworkAdapter, ServerNotifier
public class SocketServerNetworkAdapter extends Object implements ServerNetworkAdapter
Socket-based server adapter that accepts client connections and forwards incoming actions to the server controller, while pushing events back to clients.
